The '''Ht-12 heavy laser cannon''' was a model of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate utilized a pair of double Ht-12 [[Laser/Legends|laser]] cannons on his personal [[StarViper-class attack platform/Legends|starfighter]], the ''[[Virago]]''.<ref name="EGVV" />
